flows.title: Start a timer
steps: Head to Time > Timesheet, then click the +Track time button.
Choose your project and task. You can quickly select by typing the project or task name and pressing Enter.
Add notes about your work if you'd like.
Click Start timer to start a running timer while you work.

flows.title: Track time in the Week view
steps: Go to Time > Timesheet and make sure the Day/Week toggle is set to Week. The Week view needs the timer mode preference set to Track time via duration, and no required time entry notes; otherwise use the Day view.
Click + Add row, then choose your project and task and click Save row. You can quickly select by typing the project or task name and pressing Enter.
Enter your time in the new row. Click Save to store it immediately, or let Harvest save it automatically within a few seconds.

flows.title: Submit your timesheet for approval
steps: Click the Submit week for approval button in the lower right corner, then click Yes, submit timesheet to confirm.
If you've tracked only time, your timesheet submits right away. If you've also tracked expenses, you'll be taken to a review screen and need to click Submit for approval to confirm.

flows.title: Run a detailed time report
steps: Go to Reports > New report > Detailed time.
Choose a timeframe, then filter the projects or tasks you want to see using the input boxes (you can choose more than one).
Use the Change filters button to adjust the timeframe or filters, and the Export menu to export as Excel, CSV, or PDF.
